answer_1.quote: Generative, decoder-only language models such as the Generative Pretrained Transformer (GPT) series have been a particular focus of interest in part due to their multitask and few-shot capabilities.
answer_1.outputs: The models are evaluated on few-shot tasks such as analogies, arithmetic, cause and effect, emotions, empirical judgments, general knowledge, intent recognition, misconceptions, paraphrase, sentence ambiguity, and similarities abstraction.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate models on FIN-bench in zero-to three-shot settings and summarize results using mean accuracy across all tasks.
